components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors

      title: Validation message

      type: object
      properties:
        message:

          type: string

      required:

The build is green. Here's a summary of what I implemented.

## Change

The spec required that on owner creation (`POST /api/owners`), the telephone be normalized by stripping every non-digit character, require exactly 10 digits afterward, store/return the normalized 10-digit value, and reject with 400 otherwise.

Two edits:

1. **`src/main/resources/openapi.yml`** — removed the `pattern: '^[0-9]*$'` constraint on `OwnerFields.telephone`. The generated `OwnerFieldsDto` enforced that pattern via Bean Validation *before* the request reached the controller, so an input like `(04) 1234-5678` would have been rejected outright, defeating normalization. The field still has `minLength: 1` / `maxLength: 20`, and I updated the description to document the normalize-to-10-digits rule.

2. **`OwnerRestControllerV1.addOwner`** — after mapping the DTO to the `Owner`, it strips non-digits (`replaceAll("\\D", "")`), returns `400 Bad Request` when the result isn't exactly 10 digits, and otherwise stores the normalized 10-digit value before saving. The `Owner` entity's existing `@Pattern("^[0-9]{10}$")` / `@Digits` constraints remain satisfied since the stored value is always 10 digits.

The two new acceptance tests pass:
- `coreStripsToTenDigits`: `(04) 1234-5678` → stored/returned as `0412345678`.
- `errorRejectsTooFewDigits`: `12345` → `400`.

Full suite: `Tests run: 2, Failures: 0, Errors: 0` — **BUILD SUCCESS**.

Note: the change is scoped to the create endpoint per the spec; `updateOwner` was left unchanged.
